sql: SELECT * FROM ((SELECT 1 AS g, o.created_at::text AS t, coalesce(o.strategy,'-') AS c2, o.market_ticker AS c3, coalesce(o.side,'-') AS c4, o.limit_price::text AS c5, coalesce(o.status,'-') AS c6, coalesce(o.cancel_reason,'-') AS c7 FROM live_orders o WHERE o.created_at > now() - interval '8 hours' ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 12) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS g, p.captured_at::text, 'pos', p.market_ticker, coalesce(p.side,'-'), p.quantity::text, coalesce(p.realized_pnl::text,'-'), coalesce(p.market_exposure::text,'-') FROM positions p WHERE p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' OR p.market_ticker LIKE 'KXTRUMPAPPROVE-26SEP18%' ORDER BY p.captured_at DESC LIMIT 8)) u ORDER BY g, t DESC
